manifest.name: Ocean Breeze
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: A calming blue and teal theme inspired by the sea

css: :root { --bg-primary: #e8f4f8; --bg-secondary: #d4ebf2; --bg-card: #ffffff; --text-primary: #2c5f6f; --text-secondary: #5a8998; --accent: #0fa3b1; --accent-hover: #0d8a95; --border-color: #b8dce4; --shadow-color: rgba(15,163,177,0.12); } body { background: radial-gradient(circle at top right, #e0f7fa 0%, #e8f4f8 50%, #d4ebf2 100%) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } .card, .card-item { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px var(--shadow-color) !important; border-radius: 10px !important; } .card-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(15,163,177,0.18) !important; } header, .header { background-color: var(--bg-secondary) !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; } button { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 6px !important; } button:hover { background-color: var(--accent) !important; color: #fff !important; border-color: var(--accent) !important; } .modal-content, .menu-section { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 12px !important; } input, textarea, select { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-radius: 6px !important; } input:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent) !important; outline: none !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15,163,177,0.1) !important; } .tag { background-color: var(--accent) !important; color: #fff !important; border-radius: 12px !important; padding: 3px 10px !important; font-size: 0.85rem !important; } .breadcrumb a, a { color: var(--accent) !important; } .toast { background-color: var(--bg-card) !important; color: var(--text-primary) !important; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent) !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--shadow-color) !important; }
